newsitem.title: USA: NYH spot product diffs slide lower by NYMEX close.
newsitem.headline: NYH spot product diffs slide lower by NYMEX close.

text.p: New York Harbor (NYH) distillate and gasoline differentials slid lower by the NYMEX close Monday in thin, choppy market activity.
However, NYMEX prices were slightly firmer, with June heating oil up 0.13 cent and June gasoline up 0.08 cent.
U.S. Gulf differentials saw little change by mid-afternoon, traders said.
NYH prompt conventional unleaded M2 gasoline was talked between 1.75 and 2.00 cents under the screen, down about 0.50 cent on the day.
Market players said buyers appeared reluctant to purchase barrels based on expectations of lower gasoline prices in the coming days.
Prompt premium V2 gasoline in NYH also dipped, with players putting offers at 4.50 cents, down nearly 1.00 cent from Friday.
NYH No. 2 oil diffs also weakened, with barrels for delivery by the 10th of May talked near 2.00 cents over the screen, off about 0.50 cent.
Low-sulphur diesel barrels for prompt delivery in NYH were also down about 0.50 cent, with offers sitting near 3.25 cents over the print.
